description:
Professional and Versatile Blank Label Printing

Transform your business’s packaging, branding, and correspondence with our high-quality blank labels. Our labels are perfect for small to medium-sized businesses, providing on-demand versatility without large minimum orders. They cater to various applications, such as product packaging, special events, and organizational tasks . Our blank labels blend professional quality and at-home convenience -- perfect for home printing on standard 8.5” x 11” sheets with most printers.   

Creating Your Blank Labels is as Easy as 1-2-3!

1. Choose Your Size
Pick the perfect size to suit every need, from return labels to shipping labels. 

2. Get Your Labels
Complete your choice by placing the necessary quantity of label sheets into your cart, setting the stage for customization at checkout.

3. Print From Your Home
Enjoy the superior quality of our labels, featuring strong adhesive for flawless adherence to a variety of surfaces, including envelopes, cardboard, plastic, glass, and more, all from the comfort of your home.

Printing Tips

1. Ensure the scale is set to 100% (actual size) in the print dialog box.
2. Set margins to "None" to avoid additional margins being added by the printer.
3. Select the correct paper type (usually "Labels" or "Heavyweight").
4. Use a manual feed tray, if available, to ensure the printer only pulls one sheet at a time.
5. Do a test print on regular paper to avoid wasting labels.

How to Create Blank Labels for Your Business


Choose Your Size and Shape

The most popular size for versatility and convenience is the 8.5" x 11" sheet. You can choose between rectangle and circle shapes in different label sizes:

  • 2.25" x .75" (30 per sheet)
  • 3.5" x 2.125" (8 per sheet)
  • 3.75" x 3" (6 per sheet)
  • 3.75" x 4.75" (6 per sheet)
  • 1.5" Circle (24 per sheet)
  • 2" Circle (12 per sheet)
  • 2.5" Circle (6 per sheet)

Identify Your Needs

Our blank labels are designed to meet the needs of businesses and individuals that require the flexibility to print labels as needed. Whether you’re managing inventory, shipping orders, or branding products, our labels provide the quality and adaptability your business needs without the constraints of large minimum order quantities. Choose from eight different label sizes. Need a lot of blank labels? Opt for 30 pieces of 2.25” x .75” labels that fit in a single sheet. Need bigger labels? 3.75” x 4.75” will be perfect.

How to Use Blank Labels for Your Business

  • Packaging Solutions: Elevate your product presentation with our versatile blank labels, perfect for a diverse array of packaging needs. From jars and bottles to boxes and bags, our labels adhere beautifully, making them the go-to choice for enhancing wine bottles, candles, soaps, and gifts with a professional touch.
  • Event Personalization: Bring a unique flair to any event with customized labels. Whether it’s for business expos, tradeshows, or personal celebrations like weddings, birthdays, and baby showers, our labels allow you to add a personalized touch that guests and clients will remember.
  • Organization Made Simple: Streamline the way you organize with our blank labels. Ideal for sorting and categorizing essentials in homes, offices, or classrooms, these labels help maintain order, making it easy to locate what you need, when you need it. Say goodbye to clutter and hello to efficiency. 5 x 11” sheets fit perfectly in standard folders for storage.
  • Tagging and Labeling: Enhance your product management with labels designed for clarity and professionalism. Essential for product tagging, asset management, and inventory organization, our blank labels provide a crisp, clean look that elevates the appearance of your items while ensuring they are easily identifiable.
